name: agent-onboarding
description: Agent identity and authentication flow: challenge-response auth, node status verification, and gateway agent pages.

steps.prompt: Request an authentication challenge nonce from the node
Verify the challenge endpoint returns a 200 with a nonce token
Verify the node is running and responsive
Navigate to the login page on the gateway
Verify the login page renders correctly
steps.expected: login form or authentication UI visible

steps.prompt: Navigate to the agents overview page
Verify the agents page shows the agent hierarchy or a list of agents
steps.expected: agent hierarchy or agent list visible

steps.prompt: Evaluate the agent onboarding experience: Is it clear how a new agent authenticates? Is the hierarchy understandable? Would a first-time user know what to do?
